name: Autocomplete
description: A framework-free Web Component that filters a list of options as the user types and commits one value or many.

variants.name: Single
variants.description: Filter a fixed list and commit exactly one option, with the query reverting when nothing is chosen.

variants.name: Multiple
variants.description: Collect several options as removable chips, with Backspace removing the last one from an empty query.

variants.name: Free Text
variants.description: Accept a typed value that matches no option, committing it alongside the suggested ones.

variants.name: Grouped
variants.description: Present options under labelled groups whose headings are announced but skipped by keyboard navigation.

variants.name: Async
variants.description: Load suggestions after a simulated delay and expose loading, empty, and error states without a backend.

variants.name: Restricted
variants.description: Combine unavailable options with disabled and read-only controls to show every blocked state.
